title: Planning gives an item that adds an exception to a gate classifier fail-closed probes: the exception shape beside a real trigger of the class it lowers
goal: A planned check of an item that makes bl_authority read past a word (a class-lowering exception) also asserts the class holds when the exception's shape sits beside a real trigger (an action verb on the push, a remote ref, a credential qualifier, each secrets word in each shape), and precheck warns of such an item whose checks hold no such probe (SP-hlt2tdel: BG-3yjqrfkp's check passed while its exceptions read past real pushes, filed as BG-256h2xwg S1 by the review; ST-oc7hsriu's check passed with the doc-name shape unplanted)
